mix_semantics.arrival: each client independently schedules Registration+Grant every arrival_interval_sec during the sustained window
mix_semantics.relinquish: each client independently picks one of its active CBSDs uniformly (seeded) every relinquish_interval_sec; victim stops heartbeating
mix_semantics.heartbeat: per CBSD; continues until Relinquish removes it

note: Paired seeds; A=K1/B=K=n_clients; client count and offered mix fixed
